data.name: Island Notes
data.detailed_description:
Story Introduction:

After a yacht accident, you and your guests are stranded on a mysterious island. Will you survive alone or help everyone pull through together? The game blends romance, survival, crafting, farming, fishing, pet taming, and more—promising a unique survival adventure.

Game Features:

  • A vast island map featuring caves, abandoned structures, cliffs, and other special locations. With ultra-high vegetation density, nearly every environmental object can be gathered, each holding unique value.

  • Forge bonds with NPCs through a comprehensive affinity system. Each NPC features authentic voice acting to enhance immersion.

  • Intelligent NPCs capable of independent eating, cooking, resting, gathering, and combat. They dynamically adjust behavior based on player status, offering care and emotional interactions.

  • Multiple NPC outfits unlockable through affinity progression.

  • Includes all core survival elements: base building, farming, pet hatching, pet rearing, armor/weapon crafting, and more.

  • Diverse creatures (monsters) with designated habitats—each engages in all-terrain combat. Fully open-world exploration with zero player restrictions.

  • Extensive weapon variety: combat tools (axes, bows, spears, crossbows, firearms) and non-combat tools (shovels, sickles, bamboo tubes).

  • Fully open-ended gameplay—explore both land and underwater realms.

data.short_description: Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, choose self-preservation or alliances. Master base-building, farming, fishing, romance and pet taming in this morally-charged survival simulator that blends strategy with human drama. Forge bonds, conquer nature, and evolve your humanity.
